Session date: 1:45 pm on 6 August, 2022
[D18:1] John: Hey James, good catching up! Been a while huh? I made a huge call - recently left my IT job after 3 years. It was tough but I wanted something that made a difference. And now with this new job, I am happy about my decision. I am loving the new job!

[D18:4] James: Wow, John, that sounds really brave. I hope it brings you joy and satisfaction.
[D18:5] John: Thanks, James. It wasn't easy, but sometimes you gotta take a leap to follow your heart.
[D18:6] James: Taking risks pays off! Way to be brave. I'm proud of you!

Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:7] John: I was inspired by their passion for helping kids, so I wanted to contribute in any way I could. Plus, coding lets me challenge myself and expand my skills, so this was a great chance to do both. It's really rewarding to use my coding skills to make a difference.

[D11:9] John: It showed me the power of tech to make positive changes, beyond just my own enjoyment. It gave me a real sense of purpose.
[D11:10] James: Discovering our passions is truly rewarding. How do you think this experience will impact your future plans?
[D11:11] John: This experience has given me a clearer sense of purpose and motivated me to use my programming skills to make a positive impact. I'm now considering volunteer roles and potentially a career in the non-profit sector.
[D11:12] James: That's really inspiring. Have you found any non-profit organizations that align with your values and passion for programming?

[D11:15] John: I'll be happy to find a place where my skills and passions are a perfect match. I'm hoping to make a positive impact there.

[D11:17] John: Thanks, your encouragement means a lot.
